title: DeepSeek Infra 5.0 Native Rust/Go Runtime Readiness Assessment
assessment_scope: Repository snapshot only; this file is not release evidence.

blockers.detail: Native chat, model catalog, MCP, A2A and agent discovery still fail closed as unwired. Public /api isolation does not implement the authenticated proxy or full behavioral parity.
Go TransitionCutover still returns ErrCutoverNotAuthorized for states requiring production authorization. Route registration and writer-denial gates do not establish complete Go production ownership.

The optional worker S3 path now journals placement/condition and requires conditional byte verification, but operation-specific signed admission, renewable live authority, provider ownership and full process-kill/takeover recovery remain unqualified. A missing object or mismatched metadata cannot settle an uncertain in-flight write as unapplied; local library results are not release proof.
Native Three-MinIO, two-Fleet/four-MinIO, and SIGKILL/takeover workload evidence has not been produced.
No exact-head CI and Evidence Assembly artifacts qualify this native runtime snapshot.
Zero-Python and unique-writer invariants have targets and executable gates, but require live workload-measured artifacts.
